1.w: A Song of the Ascents. Of David. If YHWH had not been for us—now let Israel say—

2.w: if YHWH had not been for us, in the rising up of men against us,

3.w: then they would have swallowed us alive, in the burning of their anger against us;

4.w: then the waters would have engulfed us, the stream would have passed over our soul;

5.w: then would have passed over our soul the raging waters.

6.w: Blessed [be] YHWH, who has not given us as prey to their teeth!

7.w: Our soul like a bird has escaped from the snare of the fowlers; the snare is broken, and we have slipped away.

8.w: Our help [is] in the name of YHWH, the Maker of the heavens and the earth.
